intel.title: [CISA KEV] BeyondTrust Remote Support - BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-102764
廠商: BeyondTrust
產品: Remote Support
漏洞名稱: BeyondTrust Remote Support Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
說明: BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-10-19
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: BeyondTrust Remote Support 存在身份驗證繞過漏洞（CVE-2026-102764），攻擊者可藉由欺騙手段繞過身份驗證並在設備上執行檔案操作。該漏洞已被 CISA 列入已知被利用漏洞清單（KEV），顯示已有活躍攻擊。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Fortinet Multiple Products - Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2025-61624
廠商: Fortinet
產品: Multiple Products
漏洞名稱: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
說明: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-10-19
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: Fortinet FortiOS、FortiPAM、FortiProxy 與 FortiSwitchManager 等產品存在路徑穿越漏洞（CVE-2025-61624），並已納入 CISA KEV 漏洞清單。具備管理員與讀寫權限的已驗證攻擊者可經由特定 CLI 指令任意寫入或刪除檔案。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。
